faq.title: FAQS
faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.q1: How do I book a package?
faq.a1: Choose your package, click Book Now, fill in the form (name, phone, dates, number of guests), then submit. You will get a booking code and wait for admin confirmation via WhatsApp.
faq.q2: Can I book without an email?
faq.a2: Yes. Email is optional. Confirmation is sent via WhatsApp to the number you registered.
faq.q3: How do I cancel or change a booking?
faq.a3: Contact the admin via WhatsApp with your booking code. Cancellation is confirmed directly by the admin.
faq.a4: No extra booking fees. The displayed price is the final package price; payment is discussed directly with the admin.
faq.a5: Yes, we accept group bookings. Write the number of guests and your needs in the notes field when booking, or contact us via WhatsApp.
